name: FV_REPORTING_TRX_ACTIVITY
description: This table stores federal activity and attribute details.

columns.name: TRANSACTION_ACTIVITY_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier for the transaction activity.

columns.name: LEDGER_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of the ledger.

columns.name: FISCAL_YEAR
columns.description: The fiscal year of a period for Budgetary Control Only Calendars. Free text field. Not validated.

columns.name: PERIOD_YEAR
columns.description: Denotes the accounting calendar year represented by a numerical value, such as 2009.

columns.name: PERIOD_NAME
columns.description: Indicates the accounting period for the calendar year.

columns.name: PERIOD_NUM
columns.description: Unique period number within the accounting calendar year.

columns.name: CODE_COMBINATION_ID
columns.description: Key flexfield combination defining column.

columns.name: JE_HEADER_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier for the journal entry header.

columns.name: JE_LINE_NUM
columns.description: Line number of the journal entry.

columns.name: JE_SOURCE
columns.description: Indicates the journal entry source.

columns.name: JE_CATEGORY
columns.description: Indicates the journal category.

columns.name: JE_BATCH_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of the journal entry batch.

columns.name: EVENT_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the categorization of accounting events that is unique within an application and event class.

columns.name: GL_DATE
columns.description: Date on journal entry was created.

columns.name: POSTED_DATE
columns.description: Date journal entry header was posted.

columns.name: TRANSACTION_NUMBER
columns.description: Identifier of a business relationship involving one or more parties and products, such as a change in the ownership, location or status of a product.

columns.name: TREASURY_ACCOUNT_SYMBOL
columns.description: The identification code assigned by Treasury, in collaboration with Office of Management and Budget and the owner agency, to an individual appropriation, receipt, or other fund account.

columns.name: FUND_CODE
columns.description: An agency-defined shorthand code used to identify an individual appropriation, receipt, or other fund account or an agency subdivision of a Treasury Account Symbol.

columns.name: USSGL_ACCOUNT
columns.description: A six-digit number used to identify a specific U.S. Standard General Ledger account. The U.S. Standard General Ledger account must be in the U.S. Standard General Ledger chart of account.

columns.name: NATURAL_ACCOUNT
columns.description: The natural account segment value.

columns.name: TRADING_PARTNER_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of the Supplier or Customer.

columns.name: PARTY_USAGE_CODE
columns.description: Unique code for the party usage. A value of S indicates supplier and C indicates customer.

columns.name: AGENCY_IDENTIFIER
columns.description: The Treasury Account Symbol component associated with the trading partner which identifies the agency that is responsible for the budget account.

columns.name: MAIN_ACCOUNT_CODE
columns.description: The Treasury Account Symbol component associated with the trading partner which represents the type and purpose of the fund.

columns.name: BALANCE_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: The code for the GTAS balance type that indicates the type of balance, for example, beginning, ending, and so on. It is based on the ORA_FV_GTAS_BALANCE_TYPE lookup.

columns.name: FEDERAL_OR_NONFEDERAL_CODE
columns.description: Identifies the federal or non-federal codes associated with the account. It is based on the ORA_FV_FED_OR_NONFED_CODE lookup.

columns.name: EXCHANGE_OR_NONEXCHANGE_CODE
columns.description: Identifies the exchange or non-exchange codes associated with the account. It is based on the ORA_FV_EXCHANGE_OR_NO_EXCHANGE lookup.

columns.name: CUSTODIAL_OR_NONCUSTODIAL_CODE
columns.description: Identifies the custodial or non-custodial codes associated with the account. It is based on the ORA_FV_CUST_OR_NONCUST_CODE lookup.

columns.name: AUTHORITY_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Identifies the authority type codes associated with the account. It is based on the ORA_FV_AUTHORITY_TYPE lookup.

columns.name: APPORTIONMENT_CATEGORY_CODE
columns.description: Identifies the apportionment category codes associated with the account. It is based on the ORA_FV_APPORTIONMENT_CAT_CODE lookup.

columns.name: APPORTIONMENT_CATEGORY_B_CODE
columns.description: Indicates the apportionment category B code is defined in federal supplemental rules.

columns.name: PROGRAM_REPORT_CODE
columns.description: Indicates program reporting category code defined in federal supplemental rules.

columns.name: YEAR_OF_BUDGET_AUTHORITY_CODE
columns.description: Identifies the year of budget authority indicator code associated with the account. It is based on the ORA_FV_NEW_OR_BAL lookup.

columns.name: AVAILABILITY_TIME_CODE
columns.description: Identifies the current or subsequent codes associated with the account. It is based on the ORA_FV_CURR_OR_SUBSEQUENT lookup.

columns.name: BEA_CATEGORY_CODE
columns.description: Identifies the Budget Enforcement Act (BEA) category codes associated with the account. It is based on the ORA_FV_BEA_CATEGORY_CODE lookup.

columns.name: BORROWING_SOURCE_CODE
columns.description: Identifies the borrowing source codes associated with the account. It is based on the ORA_FV_BORROWING_SOURCE lookup.

columns.name: PYA_CODE
columns.description: Identifies the prior year adjustment codes associated with the account. It is based on the ORA_FV_PRIOR_YEAR_ADJUSTMENT lookup.

columns.name: DIRECT_OR_REIMBURSABLE_CODE
columns.description: Identifies the direct or reimbursable codes associated with the account. It is based on the ORA_FV_DIRECT_OR_REIMBURSEABLE lookup.

columns.name: BUDGET_IMPACT_INDICATOR_CODE
columns.description: Identifies the budget impact indicator codes associated with the account. It is based on the ORA_FV_BUDGT_IMPACT_INDICATOR lookup.

columns.name: CREDIT_COHORT_YEAR
columns.description: Indicates the credit cohort year segment value.

columns.name: REDUCTION_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Identifies the reduction type codes associated with the account. It is based on the ORA_FV_REDUCTION_TYPE lookup.

columns.name: DISASTER_EMERGENCY_FUND_CODE
columns.description: Indicates the disaster emergency fund code associated with the account.

columns.name: BUDGET_OBJECT_CLASS
columns.description: Indicates the budget object class associated with the account.

columns.name: DEBIT_CREDIT_INDICATOR_CODE
columns.description: Identifies the debit or credit code associated with the account. It is based on the ORA_FV_NORMAL_BALANCE lookup.

columns.name: AMOUNT_DR
columns.description: Indicates the accounted transaction debit amount.

columns.name: AMOUNT_CR
columns.description: Indicates the accounted transaction credit amount.

columns.name: DEBIT_CREDIT_CODE
columns.description: Indicates whether the journal line amount is a debit amount (DR) or credit amount (CR).

columns.name: EXCEPTION_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether the journal line has exceptions. A value of 'Y' indicates that there are exceptions.

columns.name: REPORTED_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether the journal line is already processed as part of the Bulk File Creation Process. A value of 'Y' indicates that the record is processed.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
